Key observations from the test image:
- Prominent interveinal chlorosis (yellowing between veins) on the central leaf
- Small reddish-brown spots scattered across leaves
- Leaves turning yellow/orange with some brown discoloration
- Small dark spots visible on the right leaf

Top candidates: **Sudden_death_syndrome** (interveinal chlorosis with green veins remaining), **Soybean_rust** (small pustules/spots), **Septoria_brown_spot** (dark lesions on yellowing leaves)

Comparing observations:

- **Septoria brown spot** reference shows yellowed leaves with many small dark brown spots — matches the test image very well (scattered reddish-brown spots on yellowing leaf)
- **Sudden Death Syndrome** shows more distinct interveinal chlorosis with clearly visible green veins — the test image's veins are less clearly preserved
- **Soybean rust** shows more uniform small pustules, typically on lower leaf surfaces

The test image most closely resembles Septoria brown spot: yellowed leaves with scattered small dark reddish-brown lesions, which is the hallmark of Septoria progressing up the canopy.
